[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] '''Tavin Korden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house [[House Korden]] who served as the leader of the firm [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Korden displayed a dislike for the new regime while at a meeting of Corulag's Planetary Assembly and as a result, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] began harassing him. Korden's close friend [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] shared the prince's dislike for Vader and together, Korden and Tagge developed a number of subtle schemes that worked against Vader.
